The main takeaway from our work is that
in patients with respiratory symptoms, PCD should be considered as a cause, even in those with situs inversis and Turner syndrome.

PCD should be considered in the differential diagnosis of respiratory distress in newborns, even when other congenital anomalies such as situs inversus are present, because PCD can be a primary or secondary manifestation of a genetic syndrome.
PCD should be considered as a possible cause of neonatal respiratory distress, even in the absence of a family history of the condition.
